exclusion_profiles.methodology: Hybrid-state method instantiated for the paper languages; not a theorem for arbitrary unrelated operational semantics. Stability and restricted union rules matter.
exclusion_profiles.hlpl: Paper LLBC/HLPL/HLPL+ operational fragment and local rewriting relation. Not rustc/Charon or OCaml refinement; no general unsafe/concurrent Rust semantics. No global well-formedness premise should be added unless explicitly present.
exclusion_profiles.pointer: Paper typed pointer model with compatibility/concretization maps, controlled locations and CompCert-inspired heap. Not full Rust memory/provenance, compiler correctness, or concurrency; source validity and footprint premises remain material.
exclusion_profiles.symbolic: Paper LLBC+ hybrid relation, including abstractions and identifier rules. Not an executable implementation theorem or arbitrary Rust state; restrictions in framable/semantic rules cannot be dropped.
exclusion_profiles.borrow: Paper safe core, modular borrow_checks for all functions in P and related initial states. Safety allows panic/divergence; not panic-freedom, termination, completeness of heuristics, production translation correctness or full Rust.
exclusion_profiles.join: Paper join/collapse rules. Success premises and marker/projection/shared-loan conditions are essential; no proof every heuristic search succeeds or every loop fixed point is found.
